h1: Custom Cardboard Golf Products for Events
metaDescription: Order custom cardboard golf products for your next event. Perfect for eco-friendly giveaways and branded promotions.
introHtml: Cardboard golf products offer a lightweight, eco-friendly alternative for corporate events and trade shows. Unlike traditional golf giveaways, cardboard items are fully recyclable and can be printed with your logo in full color. From custom cardboard golf scorecards to branded putters, these items are perfect for charity tournaments or office mini-golf challenges. Decoration options include offset printing and foil stamping for a polished look.
heroAltText: Custom cardboard golf scorecards and putters with full-color logo printing for corporate events
